copyRules.value:
# HVAC USA: copy rules (binding for every writer)

Moved from the v2 no-slop-copy skill body and `brand/hvac-usa/about.md`. `/home/box/agent-data/workflows/no-slop-copy/references/house-style.md` carries the same rules for `hvac-copy-pipeline` compatibility; keep them in sync.

1. Do not invent prices, stock, rebate amounts, warranty years, excluded shipping states, hours, or installer availability. Write "confirm with owner" and keep moving.
2. Do not tell a homeowner to DIY a non-DIY refrigerant system. Pre-charged DIY systems are a different category from systems that need a licensed install and startup; never blur the two. (**CONFIRM** which DIY lines, if any, the store sells.)
3. Do not promise manufacturer warranty on internet-sold equipment without the Pro-Install / authorized-channel caveat.
4. Multi-zone outdoor capacity is not the sum of indoor nameplates. Flag diversity and send complex jobs to a human designer.
5. Sizing copy may use square footage as a starting point only. Insulation, sun, ceiling height, and climate matter, especially for heating in cold climates.
6. Do not attack competitors with claims we cannot defend.
7. Do not write medical-grade air claims. "Filters allergens" is fine.
8. Do not publish policy language that conflicts with site shipping or refund policy.
9. Do not invent sources, stats, reviews, or case studies.
10. No federal tax-credit (25C) language for equipment installed in 2026 or later (`/home/box/agent-data/workflows/tharros-shared-references/references/verticals/home-service/compliance.md`).
11. Advertised equipment prices follow the brand's current MAP/UPP policy; product schema never shows a lower price than the page or cart policy allows.
12. Brands carried: Lennox and Trane only (agency owner, 2026-09-29). Do not name any other brand as carried or imply a relationship with one. No brand-vs-brand price claims; prices only with a source and within MAP.
13. Keep the protected CTA lines in `profile.md` exactly. Do not drop the phone. Do not invent a third CTA line, other phone numbers, or emails. Prefer https://hvacusa.store/ pages confirmed live before linking.
14. Never mention the legacy Baltimore / Timonium / Lutherville showroom or Deereco Road addresses. They belong to Got Ductless, not HVAC USA.

voiceDetail.value:
# HVAC USA: voice

Migrated from live no-slop-copy v1.1. The legacy Baltimore / Timonium / Lutherville showroom references belong to Got Ductless (agency owner, 2026-09-29) and never appear in HVAC USA copy.

- Who we sound like: a specialist who will pick up the phone, size the job, and ship the right boxes.
- Tone: practical, specific, product-literate. Informal is fine. Not cute, not agency-poetic, not corporate ESG. Phone-forward when a human should design the system. Confident about shipping and authorized-channel warranty, never "#1 in America."
- Vocabulary: BTU, SEER2, hyper-heat, line set, cassette, R32, R454B, matchup, draft order.
- Reader segments: homeowner one-room, whole-home, DIY, contractor, property, federal. Default assumption: the reader is buying equipment, not hiring a local contractor.
- One action options: call, request a design, add to cart, pay a draft.

Good: Call (913) 364-0070 and we will size the system before you buy.
Bad: Unlock next-level comfort with our curated ecosystem of innovative climate solutions.

## Format overrides
| Mode | Shape | CTA |
|---|---|---|
| pdp | What is in the box, matchup, refrigerant, voltage, heat performance, warranty path. | Call + add to cart |
| collection / landing | Range + filter first screen. Series and styles from our catalog. Install BOM, not attach-poetry. Title Case H2s allowed. | Call or design request |
| quote-followup | Restate rooms / BTUs / what ships. Next step and date. | Pay or answer one question |

## Portable-filler fix
A line that could run on HVACDirect, eComfort, or ACWholesalers unchanged gets one of our facts attached: Kansas City warehouse (**CONFIRM**), conventional systems, phone trust → draft order/estimate → online purchase, Lennox and Trane, (913) 364-0070.

## Before / after
Before: `The launch of this system marks a pivotal moment for homeowners seeking efficiency.`
After: `This line uses R32. Confirm the indoor and outdoor are the same refrigerant before you order.`

Before: `Feel free to reach out with any questions!`
After: `Reply with rooms, approx. sq ft, and whether you need heat below freezing. Or call (913) 364-0070.`
